title: Provisional Scrutiny & Quantification List – Assistant Professor (Food Science Technology), Advertisement No. 70
labels: Notification From Office of The Registrar
text:
PROVISIONAL SCRUTINY & QUANTIFICATION LIST

Assistant Professor – Food Science Technology | Advertisement No. 70

With reference to
Advertisement No. 70
, it is informed that all application forms received by the closing date for the post of
Assistant Professor of Food Science Technology
have been scrutinized and evaluated by the Scrutiny and Quantification Committee in accordance with the advertised criteria.

The scrutinized list, showing the marks awarded to eligible candidates and the eligibility status of applicants, including those declared ineligible, has been displayed on the University Job Portal and may be accessed through the following link:

View Provisional Scrutiny & Quantification List

VIEW SCRUTINY LIST (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/merit/nYxtV7bOAh7WADjUmjayRCVmpKcEYzh68RsTHKe1k8V6RRe4)

IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS FOR CANDIDATES

The displayed list is
provisional
and shall not be considered a final merit list.

The Provisional List may be revised, cancelled, or revoked, in whole or in part, if any information is found to be incorrect, misleading, or not in conformity with the advertised criteria, relevant Statutes, or applicable rules.

Candidates may review the marks awarded to them by the Scrutiny and Quantification Committee in each category (Academics, Distinction, Experience, Publications, and Research Projects) by logging into the Job Portal using their original application credentials.

In case of login issues, candidates may follow the instructions available on the portal to recover access.

Candidates who are not satisfied with the marks awarded to them or their eligibility status, including applicants declared ineligible, may file an appeal against the scrutiny and quantification of their applications or the determination of their eligibility, as applicable.

All objections must be clearly justified and supported by documentary evidence.

Appeals shall be considered only on the basis of documents already submitted with the original application. Candidates are strictly advised
not to submit any new documents
during the appeal process.

Appeals shall only be submitted through the online portal. Appeals submitted through any other means shall not be considered valid.

LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPEALS

December 3, 2026

No appeal shall be entertained after the stipulated deadline or through any other means.

Note:
Errors and omissions are liable to rectification.
